title: Cobbed Mace
description: A cobbed mace that spawns a cobweb on your victims 25%
body:
The Webbed Mace is a custom combat weapon that adds a chance-based control effect to melee fights. When a player is struck with the mace, there is a 25% chance that a cobweb will spawn on them, temporarily restricting their movement and creating an opening for follow-up attacks. This datapack introduces a unique twist to standard PvP by combining damage with crowd-control mechanics, making combat more strategic and unpredictable. The mace can be obtained through a custom crafting recipe (if enabled) or via command if the recipe is not installed.

When giving your self the mace, include this: `/give @s mace[custom_data={cobwebMace:true}]`
